emails.subject: credit market intelligence at hps
emails.body:
Now that HPS is part of BlackRock and expanding its private market capabilities, managing intelligence across growing portfolios gets increasingly complex.

We build Octus to streamline covenant analysis, credit market news, and legal document tracking for sub-investment grade debt.

As you scale private and liquid credit operations post-acquisition, what currently breaks for your team when managing complex loan documentation?

Best,
agneshmp07@gmail.com

emails.subject: tracking loan covenants across credit portfolios
emails.body:
Managing alternative credit portfolios often creates bottlenecks when manually tracking covenants and legal documentation across liquid and private debt deals.

We are building Octus to aggregate credit market news, restructuring data, and covenant analysis into one workflow for sub-investment grade debt.

Does manual covenant tracking and document review match your team's experience, or do you already have a smooth setup for this?

Best,
agneshmp07@gmail.com
emails.trigger_used: HPS Investment Partners manages $197B in assets under management specializing in private and liquid credit.
emails.trigger_link: Managing $197B in credit assets requires constant monitoring of covenants and legal documentation across extensive deal flow.

emails.subject: covenant analysis for hps credit portfolios
emails.body:
With BlackRock completing its acquisition of HPS to expand private market capabilities, maintaining visibility across credit documentation is essential.

Octus provides credit market intelligence, covenant analysis, and legal document tools designed for sub-investment grade debt.

If we brought you automated covenant tracking and market analysis for your credit portfolios, would you be open to reviewing it? A yes commits you to nothing.

Best,
agneshmp07@gmail.com
